doc: I42 prereg sidecar (BUILD_PLAN I42 'Theory core I: whiskering, domain locality, spanning-tree basis sufficiency' and whitepaper section 6.1-6.2). Computed at prereg by tests_m3/_i42.py::theory_core_i_doc independently of holon/ from the frozen inputs listed with their sha256. Records: (1) the 12 polymorphic Bend 2 laws in THEORY_CORE_I (3 whiskering, 4 2-cell walk/square pasting, 3 domain-locality lifting, 2 spanning-tree cycle-basis reduction); (2) the spanning-tree cycle-basis sufficiency specifications for the M2 morph_header diagram (E = 4, V = 3, kappa = 1, rank = 2; 3 laws) and the M3 header_length diagram (E = 20, V = 17, kappa = 1, rank = 4; 5 laws); (3) the 34 congruence-derived round-trip laws (2 M0 + 32 M3) proved via core_whisker_post without record unpacking, and their line-count reduction against the open_refl baseline; (4) the 7 negative canaries across all 4 theorem groups, all predicted REFUTED under both bend and bend --verdict. The build never reads this file; the tests recompute and compare against it.

laws.doc: pre-whiskering: if p(a) == q(a) for all a:A, then p(r(x)) == q(r(x)) for all x:X
post-whiskering: if p(a) == q(a) for all a:A, then l(p(a)) == l(q(a)) for all a:A
two-sided whiskering: if p(a) == q(a) for all a:A, then l(p(r(x))) == l(q(r(x))) for all x:X
2-step walk pasting: step 2-cells f1(a) == f2(a) and g1(f2(a)) == g2(f2(a)) along a 2-step walk compose to g1(f1(a)) == g2(f2(a))
3-step walk pasting: step 2-cells along a 3-step walk compose to h1(g1(f1(a))) == h2(g2(f2(a)))
horizontal 2-cell pasting: if f1 == f2 on A and g1 == g2 on B, then g1(f1(a)) == g2(f2(a))
vertical 2-cell pasting (transitivity of parallel walks): if p == q and q == s on A, then p == s on A
domain-local pre-restriction: a law on domain r(x) lifts along any refinement u: Z -> X
domain-local post-whiskering: if p(r(x)) == q(r(x)) on domain r, then l(p(r(x))) == l(q(r(x))) on domain r
domain-local vertical pasting: two parallel laws on the same domain r compose on r
spanning-tree path reduction: two edges g1, g2 reducing to the same tree path t on f(a) are equal on f(a)
fundamental-cycle basis sufficiency: a non-tree edge e with cycle generator t == e and tree round-trip law l(t(r(x))) == obs(x) satisfies l(e(r(x))) == obs(x)
non-tree walk dec_go(enc_sol(pin_h(h))) reduces to spanning-tree walk dec_go(enc_go_v0(pin_h(h))) via L_par_hdr_v0 and core_whisker_post
parallel walk dec_go(enc_sol(pin_h(h))) reduces to dec_go(enc_go_v1(pin_h(h))) via L_par_hdr_v1 and core_whisker_post
any parallel encoder walk enc_alt in the M2 header diagram reduces along the unique spanning-tree path dec_go o enc_tree to the cycle-basis generator par_gen and tree round-trip law rt_gen
non-tree edge CODEC.BatchHeaderBytes_BlobHashesHash reduces on the v2 domain to tree edge CODEC.BatchHeaderBytes_BlobCommitHash via core_tree_unique_2
non-tree edge CODEC.BatchHeaderBytes_BlobVersionedHash reduces on the v0 domain to tree edge CODEC.BatchHeaderBytes_BlobCommitHash via core_tree_unique_2
non-tree edge CODEC.BatchHeaderV1_Bytes post-whiskers with downstream decoders on the pinned v1 domain via core_whisker_post
self-loop non-tree edge CODEC.load_sol (tree_path = []) reduces under any downstream decoder via core_whisker_post when load_sol acts as identity on the domain

spanning-tree cycle-basis sufficiency for the M3 header_length diagram: any walk through a non-tree edge reduces to the unique spanning-tree path plus the 4 fundamental-cycle generators via core_cycle_basis_2

canaries.doc: swapping post-whisker observers l1 != l2 without an equality hypothesis between l1 and l2 must fail both Bend kernels
claiming full-carrier equality @a:A -> {p(a) == q(a)} from a domain-restricted hypothesis @x:X -> {p(r(x)) == q(r(x))} must fail both Bend kernels
attempting to reduce a non-tree walk l(e(r(x))) == obs(x) from the tree law l(t(r(x))) == obs(x) without the cycle-basis generator t == e must fail both Bend kernels
dropping the sequencerSetVerifyHash == 0 domain pin (pin_h) on dec_go(enc_sol(h)) == dec_go(enc_go_v0(h)) while rewriting with L_par_hdr_v0 must fail both Bend kernels
attempting to prove the v1 cycle reduction dec_go(enc_sol(PAR1.pin_h(h))) == dec_go(enc_go_v1(PAR1.pin_h(h))) using only the v0 generator L_par_hdr_v0 without L_par_hdr_v1 must fail both Bend kernels
dropping the non-tree round-trip generator RT_BHH_V2 when reducing BatchHeaderBytes_BlobHashesHash to the spanning-tree edge BatchHeaderBytes_BlobCommitHash must fail both Bend kernels
attempting to derive L_par_rt_enc_sol_BatchHeaderBytes_BatchIndex_v0 without the pin_k/pin_h domain premise must fail both Bend kernels
